answer: Clone farms cannot pre-time a moving shadow in a slot canyon. A joiner bonds 14.20 POA and draws one 18-byte sun-chip from the epoch seed XOR a 31-bit alcove lot posted 19 minutes earlier. They must pin four 11-byte shadow ticks on a hanging trellis, 92 seconds apart, each tick compared to a published harbor tide-clock and signed by two non-kin surveyors. Peers rehash the ticks and refuse a second chip in that alcove. Cost: 14.20 POA and one live pinning. A pre-drawn tick, late interval, or reused chip burns 69% and darkens the alcove for seven epochs.
